strings.jp:
悪く思わんでくださいよ…
これも戦争なんでやんす……
strings.en:
Don't hold it against me...
That's war, see......

strings.jp: ちょっと油断しただけよ…!
strings.en: I just slipped up a little...!

strings.jp: 油断は禁物でやんすよ~♪
strings.en:
Never let your guard
down, see~!

strings.jp:
あたしに敵うと思ったの?
ちょっと自信過剰じゃない?
strings.en:
Thought you could beat me?
Bit overconfident, hmm?

strings.jp:
うわぁ~!　やっぱり
ダメだぁ~!
strings.en:
Waaah~! I knew it,
no good~!
